image_description: A surreal, AI-generated image depicting a classic silver iPod Classic. The device features the standard screen and click wheel interface. However, a grotesque, melting humanoid figure with exposed skull-like features is fused into the right side of the iPod's casing, appearing to emerge from or merge with the metal body. The background is plain white.
